entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider serves as a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.

entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent memory provider uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading. It is an AGPL-3.0 open-source context database designed to improve task-completion rates.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for Hermes Agents provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system focuses on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is accessible through Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports deployment via Docker.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library for building stateful agents supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control (commit, branch, and merge). It features an interactive TUI/REPL and provides sub-100ms retrieval across five tiers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system utilizes a single SQLite database to achieve sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system combines vector search and structured facts with an auto-curated wiki. It utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context using local infrastructure like Qdrant and Redis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This lossless context management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes to ensure no message is lost during agent interactions.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes a plain-text YAML engram format for multi-agent systems. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It includes tools for memory inspection, editing, and deletion and reports a 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates fully locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It supports Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents using hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, long-term memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin is embedded by default and provides explainable retrieval via a why_retrieved tag. It features recency-aware ranking, contradiction tracking, and a loop for identifying knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp for local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and is local-first with no account required.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores data as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to prioritize high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports real, immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable, cross-session AI memory through semantic search. It includes specific tools for remembering, searching, and updating state to support cross-agent continuity for user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables APIs to charge for themselves using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking alongside tools for manual memory storage and searching.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It supports dense HNSW ANN, sparse and exact-text recall, and MinHash dedup via embedded or HTTP daemon execution modes.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider utilizes a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph methods across 17 memory management tools. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This local plugin enables private code memory for repositories through semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that provides file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.

entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code, supporting installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and features like escrow and x402 payments.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This MIT-licensed library offers 822 professional markdown-based skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It also provides ready-to-paste exports for Gemini, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT.

entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other compatible assistants. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
